author: sonnet
reason: Document A starts by defining the concepts the rest depends on: flag caching, the four write modes and the version counter. B also adds overlapping flags (`users_mirror`, `users_source`, `users_inline_copy`), so an engineer new to the project has to piece the system together from more places.
